verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation in the evidence pack describes a public status page or historical incident postmortems for Fly.io. Community reports even suggest the existing status page fails to reflect real outages ('the same page that lists our apps as under maintenance and inaccessible' — comm-3; 'their status page will show everything green' — comm-6), so there's no credible evidence this capability is delivered as the story requires.
